name: Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells beer in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company also provides water, beverages, and other products. The company was formerly known as Shunyi County Brewery and changed its name to Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd. in March 1984. Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Beijing Yanjing Brewery Investment Co., LTD.
